verdict.rationale: The Sandbox SDK explicitly enables running untrusted code securely in isolated environments, each sandbox running in its own isolated container with a full Linux environment, built on Containers and accessible from Workers. This directly matches the story of disposable, isolated sandboxes for untrusted code execution. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of 'hardware-isolated' terminology/mechanism (e.g. gVisor/microVM details) and independent hands-on corroboration of the sandbox's isolation guarantees.
